<div class="project-text">
  <h2>Evaluating the Effects of Biochar on Growth and Elemental Accumulation in Multiple Crops</h2>
  <p>
    This project analyzes biochar effects on soil and vegetation using <strong><em>Principal Component Analysis (PCA)</em></strong>, <strong><em>K-Means clustering</em></strong>, and <strong><em>ANOVA</em></strong>.
  </p>
</div>
